trigger_condition: The heuristic patchers run before the LLM. The Mermaid patcher appends 'end' whenever the error text contains 'Expecting', and most Mermaid parse errors contain that word.

trigger_condition: Apply Code appears on every assistant reply and passes the whole reply, prose included, to the diff modal as the new code.

potential_consequence: The diff preview tries to render prose plus a fence, so the preview fails or misleads the user at the moment the user decides to accept the change.

trigger_condition: Error replies are saved as assistant turns and replayed to the model. The history has no size limit and holds no earlier diagram states.

trigger_condition: Smith accepts text only. The user cannot attach an image, and the model never sees the rendered diagram.
